verdict.rationale: Logseq's docs say a new Journals page is created automatically for each day at midnight [logseq-docs-2], that the app opens on the Journals page every time [logseq-docs-24], and that it is equivalent to Roam's Daily Notes [logseq-docs-1]; a community user also praises its journalling [logseq-comm-12]. Nothing in the pack shows the daily page being pre-filled from a template, and the quick-capture templates are a different feature. missing for 10: documented default daily-journal template pre-fill, independent hands-on corroboration of the template workflow.
